editorial: Imagine a lavish spa where every whispered request feels like a promise and a threat. 'Happy Ending' unravels the intoxicating dance between customer longing and masseur restraint, turning a simple appointment into a subtle power play. Rochelle Williams’ Ina delivers a sultry, nuanced performance whose quiet shifts carry an entire spectrum of desire. Ideal viewers are those who relish erotic dramas that probe intimacy and control, diving deep into the emotional ache that shadows contact. While the pacing skids slightly in the final moments, visual poise keeps you captivated until the last frame.
